text:
maria: Quick q — if the new-ranking rollout goes sideways, who is allowed to flip the kill switch? Need the exact steps for oncall + PM escalation. cc @taylor

taylor: Short answer: oncall SREs and release engineers can flip prod flags immediately. PMs must request via incidents and wait for oncall. But we should document the exact commands and audit behaviour.

ken-sre: Confirmed. Responsible: oncall SRE, release-engineer, and platform rotation leads. Command we use:
```
rctl flags disable new-ranking --env=prod --reason="emergency"
```
That triggers an audit entry and posts to the flags-audit webhook. Example audit id appears in the webhook.

maria: Where is the concise runbook for this? I looked but found only the long one.

taylor: Runbook (short checklist): https://wiki.redwood.dev/runbooks/flag-kill-switch — contains who-to-ping, commands, and post-flip checklist. Escalation chain: @oncall-sre -> @eng-ops -> @taylor (if no ack in 10m) -> @cto if severe.

sasha-eng: Note for Dedicated customers: after disabling the flag also set routing overrides so they don't get degraded results. And notify support immediately. See step 4 in the runbook.

devops-bot: audit-log: flag_change new-ranking disabled by ken-sre (audit_id: af3b9, ts: 1769456890) :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks — can someone paste the curl for the internal flags API so I can add to the PR description?

ken-sre: curl -X POST https://flags.internal.redwood/api/v1/flags/new-ranking/actions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"action":"disable","reason":"emergency-spike-6xx"}'

  (That response includes audit_id and status)

taylor: Operational notes: 1) after flip, create a postmortem channel and collect eval diffs + latency graphs; 2) do NOT auto-reenable — manual revert only; 3) set alert to verify traffic/fallbacks worked.

oncall-sre: I'm on call now. If this goes noisy tonight, ping me and I'll run the disable and paste the audit id here.

maria: Perfect — I'll add the command + escalation chain to the feature PR and update the runbook with the dedicated-customer step. Will ping when done. :thumbsup:
